units.translation: Furthermore, the same meaning of efficient cause underlies some other expressions in which grammarians explain ὑπό by μετά (with): on which I have spoken in the Lexicon Sophocleum p. 492.
Examples of the same kind are those where it can be rendered in Latin by prae, which itself also has the meaning of efficient cause: on which see Thes. vol. 8 p. 283.
Finally, it is used for μετά (with), signifying not cause but accompaniment
The passage mentioned above can be referred to the same category.
